question: In Figure 7B-2, what two alternatives are shown for signing the downstream end of the reduced school speed-limit zone?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 7B-2 shows two alternatives for marking the downstream end of the reduced school speed limit zone: (1) an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, or (2) an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign. In both alternatives, an optional standard Speed Limit (R2-1) sign showing the downstream speed limit (45 mph in the example) may be mounted on the same post above the S5-3 or S5-2 sign. Standards (mandatory): - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." Options (permitted): - "If a reduced school speed limit zone ends at the same point as a designated school zone (see Section 7B.02), an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign may be used instead of an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign. A standard Speed Limit sign showing the speed limit for the section of highway that is downstream from the authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone may be mounted on the same post above the END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign or the END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign." - "The downstream end of a designated school zone may be identified with an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign (see Figures 7B-1 and 7B-2)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 depicts, at both ends of the zone, an "OR" arrangement showing an S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT sign with an optional R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 45 sign above it, alongside the alternative of an S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE sign, also with an optional R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 45 sign above it. [Image 2] Page 1019 contains the Section 7B.05 text establishing the S5-3 requirement (Standard §3) and the S5-2 alternative (Option §4). [Image 4] Page 1020 continues Section 7B.05 provisions on School Speed Limit assemblies. [Image 3] Page 1021 (Figure 7B-4) shows the same two downstream-end alternatives (S5-3 OR S5-2, each with optional R2-1 45) in the higher-fines-zone example. [Image 5] Page 1024 discusses the related option of using an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign where a higher fines zone ends at the same point as a reduced school speed limit zone. Citations: - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Option §4 (p.978) - Section 7B.02 Option §7 (p.976) - Page 1019
gold_answer: An END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, or an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign with a downstream Speed Limit (R2-1) sign shown as optional.
